ninja_transfers.notes: Free shipping advertised at 24hr. No minimums, no setup or art fees.

gang_sheets.label: DTF gang sheet, large
gang_sheets.fits_note: ~300 small designs or ~40 large. Dimensions inferred from the quoted per-sq-in rate, NOT confirmed on a product page.

individual_transfers._comment: Pre-printed single transfers. Priced by size, discounted by order quantity. Far more expensive per sq in than a gang sheet.
individual_transfers.CONFLICT: Ninja's tier table says 250+ is 50% off, but their cost page quotes 2x2 dropping $2.00 -> $0.70, which is 65% off. The two published sources disagree. The calculator uses the tier table (the more conservative number, producing a HIGHER cost estimate and therefore a safer price floor). Verify against a real cart before trusting deep-tier quotes.
